games.name: Unboxing Simulator [UPDATE]
games.desc:
🎁 Welcome to Unboxing Simulator 🎁
Smash boxes, uncover legendary loot, and flex your finds with friends!

[How To Play]
• Open boxes to get hats
• Equip your best hats and weapon to boost damage
• Unlock new worlds, hatch pets, and find even stronger hats
• Visit the Trade Plaza to swap epic items with other players
• Equip perks for powerful effects - some spawn extra boxes, others upgrade or even smash them for you

[Tips]
• Bigger gifts = rarer loot - team up for locked crates!
• Reach Area 3 to hatch pets - pets help you find stronger hats from boxes
• A Locked Crate spawns every 15 min - team up to crack it open for random OP loot like perks or potions

Happy smashing and good luck on the loot!

games.desc:
Use code 'Welcome' for some FREE Reflections!
Remember to leave a LIKE and join the Group for more updates and codes!

NO CONTROLLER SUPPORT

To start a dungeon, press [TAB] and then Play, or interact with the NO ENTRY gate

Maintenance begins roughly around 2:00 P.M. every Tuesday!

WARNING: THIS GAME CONTAINS BRIGHT/FLASHING LIGHTS

Project Mirror Labyrinth takes gameplay elements from multiple games, mostly Slay the Spire, Library of Ruina, and Limbus Company. PML is a roguelite deck builder taking heavy inspiration from the Project Moon universe. It takes place shortly after the events of Angela's Bad End in Library of Ruina, but contains no major spoilers, and you don't have to play LoR to understand this game.
